**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The CPS change is minimal. `xyFirst` now writes `G0 Z<tz>` before `G0 X Y` in all cases. The X/Y-first branch and the `changedAt` flag are removed everywhere.
- The clearance height still comes from the existing parameters. `traverseZ` takes the section's `ClearancePlane`, else its `RetractPlane`, never below the move's own Z. The diff adds no machine numbers to the script.
- The refusal for a stream with no stated plane is unchanged.
- I read every golden diff. All 19 files show the same shape: after each `M6` block, the `G0 X.. Y..` line and the `G0 Z..` line change places. No coordinate, feed, unit or line count changes. 18 files have one swap. `two_tool_pocket.nc` has two (one per `M6`). Total: 20 swaps, as your comment records.
- No grblHAL, TinyG or Fanuc-family golden or script is in the diff. Their pinning suite passed unchanged (below).
- The test pins are real. `the_carvera_states_the_clearance_before_any_xy_after_its_m6` asserts the first motion after the last `M6` is `G0 Z25.4`, and that no X/Y word stands between them. The old script wrote `G0 X20 Y10` first, so this pin fails on the old behavior.
- The decision file matches the `docs/decisions/README.md` format. It names the public firmware repos, the commits and the files, says "behaviour only", and lists the dropped options. The provenance header in `carvera.cps` cites the same sources.

## Results

Head reviewed: `88a926c98549e44b3670117d7fe71ff41c136a5d`.

**Self-hosted runner** (pr-test run [43613033368](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43613033368), macOS, trial-merged with main `389fe96c`):
- Post suites: ok in 42 s. This covers `first_traverse_clearance`, `script_carvera` and `recorded_streams`.
- App suites: FAIL in 1228 s. The only failing binary is `lead_approach` (2 tests). See the note below — this failure is not from this PR.

**Local, Windows**, in a review worktree merged with current main `1f6a74be5` (automatic merge, no conflicts):
- `camcraft-post --test first_traverse_clearance`: 8 pass.
- `camcraft-post --test script_carvera`: 11 pass.
- `camcraft-post --test recorded_streams`: 12 pass.
- `camcraft-post --test first_traverse_clearance_fanuc_family`: 9 pass (grblHAL, TinyG, Fanuc-family order unchanged).
- `camcraft-app --test carvera_post`: 4 pass.
- `camcraft-app --test conformance`: 7 pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**About the `lead_approach` failure:** the same two tests fail on plain main, with no changes from this PR:

```
thread 'the_reported_keep_down_helix_pocket_enters_every_level_once' panicked at crates/app/tests/lead_approach.rs:108:5:
the stock-source pocket cuts the user's part: []
```

I ran `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test lead_approach` on `origin/main` (`1f6a74be5`) alone: 4 pass, 2 fail — the same two. The post-merge gate for that main commit also failed on the app suites. This is the red main already tracked on issue #1675 (a `lead_approach` expectation changed after #1656). This PR touches no generation or verify code, so I do not count it as a finding on this PR.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `docs/decisions/1616-carvera-after-m6.md`, "Goldens" paragraph: it says the goldens are "not regenerated in this PR". The last commit does regenerate them, with your approval. A one-line edit on a future push, or at the cut, keeps the ledger true. The PR body carries the same stale line; your comment records the approval.
- The firmware defaults (`coordinate.clearance_z`, the soft Z limit) are taken on trust, as the decision file says. A machine that changed them behaves differently.

## Not exercised

- Not run on a real Carvera machine. The after-M6 order rests on the public firmware source, not on a machine reading.
- Not run with changed soft limits or a changed machine `clearance_z`.
- The heavy release-tier lanes were not run (quick tier only, per gate law).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
